title.zh: 卷512 列傳二百九十九 土司傳一 湖广
title.en: Volume 512 Biographies 299: Native Chieftain Biographies 1: Huguang
title.raw: 卷512 列傳二百九十九 土司傳一 湖广

sentences.zh: 西南諸省，水復山重，草木蒙昧，雲霧晦冥，人生其間，叢叢虱虱，言語飲食，迥殊華風，曰苗、曰蠻，史冊屢紀，顧略有區別。

translations.literal: The southwestern provinces have waters folding back and mountains piled high; vegetation is dim; clouds and mist are dark and obscure. People living among them swarm like lice in clusters; their speech and food are utterly unlike Han customs. They are called Miao and Man; historical records note them repeatedly, though with some distinction.
translations.idiomatic: In the southwestern provinces, rivers double back and mountains rise in layers; vegetation lies in a haze, and clouds and fog shut out the light. Those who live there teem like lice in clusters; their language and diet are wholly unlike Han ways. Histories call them Miao and Man and record them often, though not without distinction.

sentences.zh: 無君長不相統屬之謂苗，各長其部割據一方之謂蠻。

translations.literal: Those without rulers and not subject to mutual subordination are called Miao; those each ruling their own section and holding a territory are called Man.
translations.idiomatic: Groups without a chief or mutual subordination are termed Miao; those each headed by its own leader and holding a separate territory are termed Man.

sentences.zh: 若粵之僮、之黎，黔、楚之瑤，四川之倮儸、之生番，雲南之野人，皆苗之類。

translations.literal: Such as the Zhuang and Li of Guangdong, the Yao of Guizhou and Chu, the Luoluo and raw tribes of Sichuan, and the wild tribes of Yunnan—all are of the Miao type.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhuang and Li of Guangdong, the Yao of Guizhou and the Chu region, the Luoluo and raw tribes of Sichuan, and the wild tribes of Yunnan—all belong to the Miao category.

sentences.zh: 若漢書：「南夷君長以十數，夜郎最大。

translations.literal: As the Book of Han states: "There are several dozen southern Yi chieftains; Yelang is the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: As the Book of Han puts it: "Several dozen southern Yi chieftains exist; Yelang is the largest.

sentences.zh: 其西，靡莫之屬以十數，滇最大。

translations.literal: To its west, the Mimo dependents number in the tens; Dian is the greatest.
translations.idiomatic: West of them, the Mimo group numbers in the tens; Dian is the largest.

sentences.zh: 自滇以北，君長以十數，卭都最大。」

translations.literal: North of Dian, chieftains number in the tens; Qiongdu is the greatest."
translations.idiomatic: North of Dian, chieftains again number in the tens; Qiongdu is the greatest."

sentences.zh: 在宋為羈縻州。

translations.literal: Under the Song they were jimi prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song they became jimi prefectures.

sentences.zh: 在元為宣慰、宣撫、招討、安撫、長官等土司。

translations.literal: Under the Yuan they were native offices of Pacification Commission, Pacification Prefecture, Punitive Pacification, Soothing Commission, Chief Official, and the like.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan they became native offices of various ranks: pacification commissions, pacification prefectures, punitive pacification commissions, soothing commissions, chief-official domains, and the like.

sentences.zh: 湖廣之田、彭，四川之謝、向、冉，廣西之岑、韋，貴州之安、楊，雲南之刀、思，遠者自漢、唐，近亦自宋、元，各君其君，各子其子，根柢深固，族姻互結。

translations.literal: The Tian and Peng of Huguang, the Xie, Xiang, and Ran of Sichuan, the Cen and Wei of Guangxi, the An and Yang of Guizhou, and the Dao and Si of Yunnan—some dating from Han and Tang, others only from Song and Yuan—each ruled their own domain and passed rule to their sons; their roots ran deep and clans intermarried.
translations.idiomatic: The Tian and Peng of Huguang, the Xie, Xiang, and Ran of Sichuan, the Cen and Wei of Guangxi, the An and Yang of Guizhou, and the Dao and Si of Yunnan—some lineages reaching back to Han and Tang, others only to Song and Yuan—each kept its own lord and hereditary succession; their foundations were deep and their kin networks tightly interwoven.

sentences.zh: 假我爵祿，寵之名號，乃易為統攝，故奔走惟命，皆蠻之類。

translations.literal: Granted our ranks and stipends and honored with titles, they were easily brought under control; hence they hastened at command—all of the Man type.
translations.idiomatic: Once granted imperial ranks and stipends and honored with titles, they could readily be brought under control, and so they hurried to obey every order—all belonging to the Man category.

sentences.zh: 明代播州、藺州、水西、麓川，皆勤大軍數十萬，殫天下力而後剷平之。

translations.literal: In the Ming, Bozhou, Linzhou, Shuixi, and Luchuan all required mobilizing armies of several hundred thousand and exhausting the empire's strength before they could be eradicated.
translations.idiomatic: In the Ming, Bozhou, Linzhou, Shuixi, and Luchuan each took armies of hundreds of thousands and the full exertion of the realm before they could finally be suppressed.

sentences.zh: 故云、貴、川、廣恆視土司為治亂。

translations.literal: Hence Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Guangxi always regarded the native chieftains as the measure of order and disorder.
translations.idiomatic: For this reason Yunnan, Guizhou, Sichuan, and Guangxi always took the native chieftains as the barometer of peace and turmoil.

sentences.zh: 清初因明制，屬平西、定南諸籓鎮撫之。

translations.literal: In the early Qing the Ming system was retained, and they were placed under the pacification of the Pingxi, Dingnan, and other princely fiefs.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing the Ming arrangements were kept, and these domains were left to the pacification of the Pingxi, Dingnan, and other princely establishments.

sentences.zh: 康熙三年，吳三桂督雲、貴兵兩路討水西宣慰安坤之叛，平其地，設黔西、平遠、大定、威寧四府。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi, Wu Sangui directed Yunnan-Guizhou troops on two routes to suppress the rebellion of An Kun, Pacification Commissioner of Shuixi; he pacified the region and established the four prefectures of Qianxi, Pingyuan, Dading, and Weining.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 (1664), Wu Sangui led Yunnan-Guizhou forces on two routes against the rebellion of An Kun, pacification commissioner of Shuixi; after pacifying the territory he established the four prefectures of Qianxi, Pingyuan, Dading, and Weining.

sentences.zh: 三籓之亂，重啗土司兵為助。

translations.literal: In the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, native chieftain troops were heavily recruited as auxiliaries.
translations.idiomatic: During the Revolt of the Three Feudatories, native chieftain forces were heavily enlisted as allies.

sentences.zh: 及叛籓戡定，餘威震於殊俗。

translations.literal: When the rebel princes were suppressed, the remaining awe shook the frontier peoples.
translations.idiomatic: Once the rebel princes were crushed, the lingering prestige of the dynasty awed the frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 至雍正初，而有改土歸流之議。

translations.literal: By the early Yongzheng reign there arose discussion of gaitu liuqu—replacing native rule with regular administration.
translations.idiomatic: By the early Yongzheng reign the policy of gaitu liuqu—replacing native chieftains with regular officials—was under debate.

sentences.zh: 四年春，以鄂爾泰巡撫雲南兼總督事，奏言：「雲貴大患，無如苗蠻。

translations.literal: In the spring of the fourth year, Ortai was made governor of Yunnan with concurrent charge as governor-general, and memorialized: "The greatest calamity of Yunnan and Guizhou is none other than the Miao and Man.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of Yongzheng 4 (1726), Ortai was appointed governor of Yunnan with concurrent duties as governor-general and memorialized: "Yunnan and Guizhou's gravest trouble is none other than the Miao and Man.

sentences.zh: 欲安民必先制夷，欲制夷必改土歸流。

translations.literal: To settle the people one must first control the Yi; to control the Yi one must carry out gaitu liuqu.
translations.idiomatic: To secure the people one must first subdue the frontier tribes; to subdue them one must replace native chieftains with regular administration.

sentences.zh: 而苗疆多與鄰省犬牙相錯，又必歸併事權，始可一勞永逸。

translations.literal: Yet the Miao frontier largely interlocks with neighboring provinces like dog's teeth; authority must also be consolidated before a lasting solution can be achieved.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Miao frontier largely interlocks with neighboring provinces in jagged boundaries; administrative authority must also be consolidated before the problem can be settled once and for all.

sentences.zh: 即如東川、烏蒙、鎮雄，皆四川土府。

translations.literal: Take Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong—all native prefectures of Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Take Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong—all were native prefectures under Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 東川與滇一嶺之隔，至滇省城四百餘里，而距四川成都千有八百里。

translations.literal: Dongchuan is separated from Yunnan by only one ridge; it is a little over four hundred li from the Yunnan provincial capital, yet more than eighteen hundred li from Chengdu in Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan lies only one ridge away from Yunnan—just over four hundred li from the provincial capital of Yunnan, yet more than eighteen hundred li from Chengdu in Sichuan.

sentences.zh: 去冬，烏蒙土府攻掠東川，滇兵擊退，而川省令箭方至。

translations.literal: Last winter the Wumeng native prefecture raided Dongchuan; Yunnan troops repelled them, and only then did Sichuan's dispatch orders arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Last winter the Wumeng native prefecture attacked Dongchuan; Yunnan troops drove them off, and only then did Sichuan's dispatch orders arrive.

sentences.zh: 烏蒙至滇省城亦僅六百餘里。

translations.literal: Wumeng likewise is only a little over six hundred li from the Yunnan provincial capital.
translations.idiomatic: Wumeng, too, is only a little over six hundred li from the Yunnan provincial capital.

sentences.zh: 自康熙五十三年土官祿鼎乾不法，欽差、督、撫會審畢節，以流官交質始出，益無忌憚。

translations.literal: Since the fifty-third year of Kangxi, when the native official Lu Dingqian acted unlawfully, imperial commissioners and the governor-general and governor jointly tried Bi Jie; only when a regular official was exchanged as hostage did he emerge—and thereafter he grew ever more reckless.
translations.idiomatic: Since Kangxi 53 (1714), when the native official Lu Dingqian broke the law, imperial commissioners and the provincial governors jointly tried Bi Jie; Lu emerged only after a regular official was sent in as hostage—and from then on he grew ever bolder.

sentences.zh: 其錢糧不過三百餘兩，而取於下者百倍。

translations.literal: Their registered tax grain amounted to only a little over three hundred taels, yet what they exacted from the people was a hundredfold.
translations.idiomatic: Their registered tax grain came to only a little over three hundred taels, yet what they extracted from the people was a hundred times as much.

sentences.zh: 一年四小派，三年一大派。

translations.literal: Four minor levies each year, one major levy every three years.
translations.idiomatic: They imposed four minor levies each year and one major levy every three years.

sentences.zh: 小派計錢，大派計兩。

translations.literal: Minor levies were reckoned in cash; major levies in taels of silver.
translations.idiomatic: Minor levies were counted in cash; major levies in taels of silver.

sentences.zh: 土司一取子婦，則土民三載不敢婚。

translations.literal: When a native chieftain took a bride, the native people dared not marry for three years.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever a native chieftain took a bride, the common people dared not marry for three years.

sentences.zh: 土民有罪被殺，其親族尚出墊刀數十金，終身無見天日之期。

translations.literal: When a native person guilty of a crime was executed, his kin still had to pay several tens in gold as "knife-pad" compensation, and he had no hope of seeing daylight again in his lifetime.
translations.idiomatic: When a native subject was executed for a crime, his kin still had to pay dozens of taels in gold as "knife-pad" compensation—and the condemned had no hope of daylight again in his lifetime.

sentences.zh: 東川已改流三十載，仍為土目盤踞，文武長寓省城，膏腴四百里，無人敢墾。

translations.literal: Dongchuan had been under regular administration for thirty years, yet was still dominated by native headmen; civil and military officials long resided at the provincial capital, and four hundred li of fertile land went untilled for lack of anyone daring to reclaim it.
translations.idiomatic: Dongchuan had been under regular administration for thirty years, yet native headmen still held sway; civil and military officials lodged at the provincial capital, and four hundred li of fertile land lay unreclaimed because no one dared to farm it.

sentences.zh: 若東川、烏蒙、鎮雄改隸雲南，俾臣得相機改流，可設三府一鎮，永靖邊氛。

translations.literal: If Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong were transferred to Yunnan, enabling your servant to carry out gaitu liuqu as opportunity allows, three prefectures and one garrison could be established to pacify the frontier permanently.
translations.idiomatic: If Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong were reassigned to Yunnan so that I might carry out gaitu liuqu as circumstances allow, three prefectures and one garrison could be established to settle the frontier for good.

sentences.zh: 此事連四川者也。

translations.literal: This matter concerns Sichuan as well.
translations.idiomatic: This matter involves Sichuan as well.

sentences.zh: 廣西土府州縣峒寨等司五十餘員，分隸南寧、太平、思恩、慶遠四府，多狄青征儂智高、王守仁征田州時所留設。

translations.literal: Guangxi has more than fifty native prefectures, districts, dong stockades, and similar offices, distributed under the four prefectures of Nanning, Taiping, Si'en, and Qingyuan—most left over from Di Qing's campaign against Nong Zhigao and Wang Shouren's campaign against Tianzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi has more than fifty native prefectures, districts, stockade offices, and the like, distributed under Nanning, Taiping, Si'en, and Qingyuan—most of them remnants of Di Qing's campaign against Nong Zhigao and Wang Shouren's campaign against Tianzhou.

sentences.zh: 其邊患，除泗城土府外，餘皆土目，橫於土司。

translations.literal: Their frontier troubles, apart from the Sicheng native prefecture, all stem from native headmen who lord it over the tusi domains.
translations.idiomatic: Their frontier troubles, apart from the Sicheng native prefecture, all arise from native headmen who throw their weight around within the chieftain domains.

sentences.zh: 且黔、粵向以牂牁江為界，而粵之西隆州與黔之普安州逾江互相鬥入，苗寨寥闊，文武動輒推諉。

translations.literal: Moreover, Guizhou and Guangdong had long taken the Zangge River as their boundary, yet Xilong Prefecture of Guangdong and Pu'an Prefecture of Guizhou crossed the river and encroached on each other; Miao stockades stretched vast and empty, and civil and military officials constantly shifted blame.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Guizhou and Guangdong had long taken the Zangge River as their boundary, yet Guangdong's Xilong and Guizhou's Pu'an crossed the river and encroached on each other; Miao stockades sprawled across a vast empty frontier, and civil and military officials constantly passed the buck.

sentences.zh: 應以江北歸黔，江南歸粵，增州設營，形格勢禁。

translations.literal: The north bank should go to Guizhou and the south bank to Guangdong; additional prefectures and garrisons should be established to check one another by geography and force.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank should belong to Guizhou and the south bank to Guangdong; additional prefectures and garrisons should be set up so that terrain and power mutually constrain each other.

sentences.zh: 此事連廣西者也。

translations.literal: This matter concerns Guangxi as well.
translations.idiomatic: This matter involves Guangxi as well.

sentences.zh: 滇邊西南界以瀾滄江，江外為車里、緬甸、老撾諸土司。

translations.literal: Yunnan's southwestern frontier is bounded by the Lancang River; beyond the river lie the native domains of Cheli, Burma, Laos, and others.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan's southwestern frontier is marked by the Lancang River; beyond the river lie the native domains of Cheli, Burma, Laos, and the like.

sentences.zh: 其江內之滇沅、威遠、元江、新平、普洱、茶山諸夷，巢穴深邃，出沒魯魁、哀牢間，無事近患腹心，有事遠通外國，自元迨明，代為邊害。

translations.literal: Within the river, the Yi of Dianyuan, Weiyuan, Yuanjiang, Xinping, Pu'er, Chashan, and elsewhere have deep lairs and roam between Luokui and Ailao; in peace they menace the heartland nearby, in crisis they link with foreign states afar—from Yuan through Ming they were frontier scourges generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: Within the river, the tribes of Dianyuan, Weiyuan, Yuanjiang, Xinping, Pu'er, Chashan, and elsewhere nest in deep fastnesses and roam between Luokui and Ailao; in quiet times they threaten the interior, in crisis they reach out to foreign powers—from Yuan through Ming they were a perennial frontier scourge.

sentences.zh: 論者謂江外宜土不宜流，江內宜流不宜土。

translations.literal: Commentators say that beyond the river native rule is fitting and regular administration is not; within the river regular administration is fitting and native rule is not.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators hold that beyond the river native chieftains are appropriate and regular officials are not, while within the river regular officials are appropriate and native chieftains are not.

sentences.zh: 此雲南宜治之邊夷也。

translations.literal: These are the frontier peoples of Yunnan that ought to be governed.
translations.idiomatic: These are the frontier peoples of Yunnan that ought to be brought under control.

sentences.zh: 貴州土司向無鉗束群苗之責，苗患甚於土司。

translations.literal: Guizhou's native chieftains had never borne responsibility for restraining the Miao masses; Miao troubles exceeded those of the chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou's native chieftains had never been charged with restraining the Miao clans; the Miao menace outweighed that of the chieftains themselves.

sentences.zh: 而苗疆四周幾三千餘里，千有三百餘寨，古州踞其中，群砦環其外。

translations.literal: The Miao frontier extends nearly three thousand li on all sides, with more than thirteen hundred stockades; Guzhou sits at the center, and clusters of forts ring it without.
translations.idiomatic: The Miao frontier spans nearly three thousand li on every side, with more than thirteen hundred stockades; Guzhou sits at the center while clusters of forts ring it on the outside.

sentences.zh: 左有清江可北達楚，右有都江可南通粵，皆為頑苗蟠據，梗隔三省，遂成化外。

translations.literal: To the left the Qing River could reach Chu in the north; to the right the Du River could reach Guangdong in the south—both held fast by stubborn Miao, blocking three provinces and turning the region into land beyond civilization.
translations.idiomatic: To the left the Qing River could reach Chu in the north; to the right the Du River could reach Guangdong in the south—both held by stubborn Miao, cutting off three provinces and reducing the region to land beyond the pale.

sentences.zh: 如欲開江路以通黔、粵，非勒兵深入，遍加剿撫不可。

translations.literal: To open the river route and link Guizhou and Guangdong, troops must be driven deep and pacification carried out everywhere—nothing less will suffice.
translations.idiomatic: To open the river route and link Guizhou and Guangdong, troops must be driven deep and thorough pacification carried out—nothing less will do.

sentences.zh: 此貴州宜治之邊夷也。

translations.literal: These are the frontier peoples of Guizhou that ought to be governed.
translations.idiomatic: These are the frontier peoples of Guizhou that ought to be brought under control.

sentences.zh: 臣思前明流土之分，原因煙瘴新疆，未習風土，故因地制宜，使之鄉導彈壓。

translations.literal: Your servant reflects that the Ming division between regular and native administration arose because the new frontier lands were miasmal and unfamiliar; officials were unaccustomed to local conditions, so policy adapted to place, using natives as guides and to suppress unrest.
translations.idiomatic: Your servant reflects that the Ming division between regular and native rule arose because the new frontier was miasmal and unfamiliar and officials unaccustomed to local conditions—so policy adapted to place, using natives as guides and to keep order.

sentences.zh: 今歷數百載，相沿以夷治夷，遂至以盜治盜，苗、倮無追贓抵命之憂，土司無革職削地之罰，直至事大上聞，行賄詳結，上司亦不深求，以為鎮靜邊民無所控訴；

translations.literal: Now, after several hundred years, rule by Yi over Yi has continued until thieves rule thieves; Miao and Luo have no fear of restitution or capital punishment, and native chieftains face no penalty of dismissal or land confiscation—only when matters grow grave and reach the throne do they bribe their way to a closed report, and superiors do not investigate deeply, thinking that to keep the frontier quiet means the people have no grievances;
translations.idiomatic: Now, after several hundred years, governing Yi through Yi has continued until thieves govern thieves; Miao and Luo need not fear restitution or execution, and native chieftains face no dismissal or confiscation—only when affairs grow grave and reach the throne do they bribe their way to a closed report, and superiors do not press the matter, thinking frontier quiet means the people have no grievances;

sentences.zh: 若不剷蔓塞源，縱兵刑財賦事事整飭，皆治標而非治本。

translations.literal: if the vines are not cut and the source blocked, then even if troops, punishments, and taxes are all put in order, it is treating symptoms, not the root.
translations.idiomatic: unless the vines are cut and the source blocked, then even if troops, punishments, and taxes are all put in order, it treats symptoms, not the root.

sentences.zh: 其改流之法，計擒為上，兵剿次之。

translations.literal: The method of gaitu liuqu: stratagem and capture rank first; military suppression second.
translations.idiomatic: The method of replacing native rule: stratagem and capture come first; military suppression second.

sentences.zh: 令其自首為上，勒獻次之。

translations.literal: Inducing voluntary surrender ranks first; compelled submission second.
translations.idiomatic: Inducing voluntary surrender comes first; compelled submission second.

sentences.zh: 惟制夷必先練兵，練兵必先選將。

translations.literal: Only by training troops first can the Yi be controlled; only by selecting generals first can troops be trained.
translations.idiomatic: Only by training troops first can the frontier tribes be controlled; only by selecting commanders first can troops be trained.

sentences.zh: 誠能賞罰嚴明，將士用命，先治內，後攘外，必能所向奏效，實雲貴邊防百世之利。」

translations.literal: If rewards and punishments are strict and clear and officers and men obey, governing the interior first and then repelling outsiders, success is sure wherever one turns—it would truly be a benefit to Yunnan-Guizhou frontier defense for a hundred generations."
translations.idiomatic: If rewards and punishments are strict and clear and officers and men obey orders, pacifying the interior first and then repelling outsiders, success is assured wherever one turns—it would truly secure Yunnan-Guizhou's frontier for generations to come."

sentences.zh: 世宗知鄂爾泰才，必能辦寇，即詔以東川、烏蒙、鎮雄三土府改隸雲南。

translations.literal: The Shizong Emperor knew Ortai's talent and that he could handle the bandits; he immediately ordered the three native prefectures of Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong transferred to Yunnan.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongzheng Emperor knew Ortai's ability and that he could handle the frontier; he immediately ordered the three native prefectures of Dongchuan, Wumeng, and Zhenxiong reassigned to Yunnan.

sentences.zh: 六年，復鑄三省總督印，令鄂爾泰兼制廣西。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the seal of the three-province governor-general was recast, and Ortai was ordered to govern Guangxi concurrently.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year the seal of the three-province governor-general was recast, and Ortai was placed in concurrent charge of Guangxi.

sentences.zh: 於是自四年至九年，蠻悉改流，苗亦歸化，間有叛逆，旋即平定。

translations.literal: Thus from the fourth to the ninth year, the Man were all converted to regular administration, the Miao also submitted; occasional rebellions were swiftly pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Thus from the fourth to the ninth year the Man domains were all converted to regular administration and the Miao submitted; occasional rebellions were swiftly put down.

sentences.zh: 其間如雍正朝古州苗疆之蕩平，乾隆朝四川大小金川之誅鋤，光緒朝西藏瞻對之征伐，皆事之钜者，分見於篇。

translations.literal: Among them, such great affairs as the pacification of the Guzhou Miao frontier in the Yongzheng reign, the extermination of the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan in Sichuan in the Qianlong reign, and the campaign against Zhandui in Tibet in the Guangxu reign are treated separately in their respective chapters.
translations.idiomatic: Among them, such major campaigns as the pacification of the Guzhou Miao frontier under Yongzheng, the suppression of the Greater and Lesser Jinchuan in Sichuan under Qianlong, and the expedition against Zhandui in Tibet under Guangxu are treated separately in their respective chapters.

sentences.zh: 其土官銜號，曰宣慰司，曰宣撫司，曰招討司，曰安撫司，曰長官司。

translations.literal: Their native official titles were: Pacification Commission, Pacification Prefecture, Punitive Pacification Commission, Soothing Commission, and Chief Official.
translations.idiomatic: Their native official titles were pacification commission, pacification prefecture, punitive pacification commission, soothing commission, and chief official.

sentences.zh: 以勞績之多寡，分尊卑之等差，而府、州、縣之名亦往往有之。

translations.literal: According to the amount of merit, ranks of high and low were distinguished; names of prefecture, department, and district also often appeared.
translations.idiomatic: Ranks of high and low were distinguished according to merit, and titles of prefecture, department, and district also often appeared.

sentences.zh: 今土司之未改流者，四川宣撫使二：曰卭部，曰沙馬。

translations.literal: Of native chieftains not yet converted to regular administration today, Sichuan has two pacification commissioners: Qiongdu and Shama.
translations.idiomatic: Of native chieftains not yet converted to regular administration today, Sichuan has two pacification commissioners: Qiongdu and Shama.

sentences.zh: 宣慰司五：曰木坪，曰明正，曰巴底，曰巴旺，曰德爾格忒。

translations.literal: Five pacification commissions: Muping, Mingzheng, Badi, Bawang, and De'erge.
translations.idiomatic: Five pacification commissions: Muping, Mingzheng, Badi, Bawang, and De'erge.

sentences.zh: 安撫使二十有一：曰長寧，曰沃日，曰瓦寺，曰梭磨，曰瓜別，曰木裏，曰革布希劄，曰巴底，曰綽斯甲布，曰喇袞，曰瓦述餘科，曰霍耳竹窩，曰霍耳章谷，曰霍耳孔撒，曰霍耳咱，曰林蔥，曰霍耳甘孜麻書，曰霍耳東科，曰春科，曰下瞻對，曰上納奪。

translations.literal: Twenty-one soothing commissioners: Changning, Wo'er, Wasi, Suomo, Guabie, Muli, Gebuxizha, Badi, Chuosijia, Lagun, Washuyuke, Huo'er Zhuwo, Huo'er Zhanggu, Huo'er Kongsa, Huo'er Zha, Lincong, Huo'er Ganzi Mashu, Huo'er Dongke, Chunke, Xia Zhandui, and Shang Na'duo.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-one soothing commissioners: Changning, Wo'er, Wasi, Suomo, Guabie, Muli, Gebuxizha, Badi, Chuosijia, Lagun, Washuyuke, Huo'er Zhuwo, Huo'er Zhanggu, Huo'er Kongsa, Huo'er Zha, Lincong, Huo'er Ganzi Mashu, Huo'er Dongke, Chunke, Lower Zhandui, and Upper Na'duo.

sentences.zh: 長官司二十有九：曰靜州，曰隴木，曰嶽希，曰松岡，曰卓克基，曰威龍州，曰陽地隘口，曰黨壩，曰河東，曰阿都正，曰普濟州，曰昌州，曰沈邊，曰冷邊，曰瓦述啯隴，曰瓦述毛丫，曰瓦述曲登，曰瓦述色他，曰瓦述更平，曰霍耳納林沖，曰霍耳白利，曰春科高日，曰上瞻對，曰蒙葛結，曰泥溪，曰平夷，曰蠻夷，曰沐川，曰九姓。

translations.literal: Twenty-nine chief officials: Jingzhou, Longmu, Yuexi, Songgang, Zhuokeji, Weilong, Yangdi'aikou, Dangba, Hedong, Aduzheng, Pujizhou, Changzhou, Shenbian, Lengbian, Washu Gonglong, Washu Maoya, Washu Qudeng, Washu Seta, Washu Gengping, Huo'er Nalinchong, Huo'er Baili, Chunke Gaori, Shang Zhandui, Menggejie, Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Muchuan, and Jiuxing.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-nine chief officials: Jingzhou, Longmu, Yuexi, Songgang, Zhuokeji, Weilong, Yangdi'aikou, Dangba, Hedong, Aduzheng, Pujizhou, Changzhou, Shenbian, Lengbian, Washu Gonglong, Washu Maoya, Washu Qudeng, Washu Seta, Washu Gengping, Huo'er Nalinchong, Huo'er Baili, Chunke Gaori, Upper Zhandui, Menggejie, Nixi, Pingyi, Manyi, Muchuan, and Jiuxing.

sentences.zh: 雲南宣慰使一：曰車里。

translations.literal: Yunnan has one pacification commissioner: Cheli.
translations.idiomatic: Yunnan has one pacification commissioner: Cheli.

sentences.zh: 宣撫使五：曰耿馬，曰隴川，曰幹厓，曰南甸，曰孟連。

translations.literal: Five pacification prefects: Gengma, Longchuan, Ganya, Nandian, and Menglian.
translations.idiomatic: Five pacification prefects: Gengma, Longchuan, Ganya, Nandian, and Menglian.

sentences.zh: 副宣撫使二：曰遮放，曰盞達。

translations.literal: Two deputy pacification prefects: Zhefang and Zhanda.
translations.idiomatic: Two deputy pacification prefects: Zhefang and Zhanda.

sentences.zh: 安撫使三：曰路江，曰芒市，曰猛卯。

translations.literal: Three soothing commissioners: Lujiang, Mangshi, and Mengmao.
translations.idiomatic: Three soothing commissioners: Lujiang, Mangshi, and Mengmao.

sentences.zh: 副長官司三：曰納樓，曰虧容甸，曰十二關，土府四：曰蒙化，曰景東，曰孟定，曰永寧。

translations.literal: Three deputy chief officials: Nalou, Kuirongdian, and Shierguan; four native prefectures: Menghua, Jingdong, Mengding, and Yongning.
translations.idiomatic: Three deputy chief officials: Nalou, Kuirongdian, and Shierguan; four native prefectures: Menghua, Jingdong, Mengding, and Yongning.

sentences.zh: 土州四：曰富州，曰灣甸，曰鎮康，曰北勝。

translations.literal: Four native departments: Fuzhou, Wandian, Zhenkang, and Beisheng.
translations.idiomatic: Four native departments: Fuzhou, Wandian, Zhenkang, and Beisheng.

sentences.zh: 貴州長官司六十有二：曰中曹，曰白納，曰養龍，曰虎墜，曰程番，曰上馬，曰小程，曰盧番，曰方番，曰違番，曰羅番，曰臥龍，曰小龍，曰大龍，曰金石，曰大平，曰小平，曰大谷龍，曰小谷龍，曰木瓜，曰麻鄉，曰新添，曰平伐，曰羊場，曰慕役，曰頂營，曰沙營，曰楊義，曰都勻，曰邦水，曰思南，曰豐寧上，曰豐寧下，曰爛土，曰平定，曰樂平，曰卭水，曰偏橋，曰蠻夷，曰沿河，曰郎溪，曰都坪，曰黃道，曰都素，曰施溪，曰潭溪，曰新化，曰歐陽，曰亮寨，曰湖耳，曰中林，曰八舟，曰龍里，曰古州，曰洪州，曰省溪，曰提溪，曰烏羅，曰平頭，曰垂西，曰抵寨，曰岩門。

translations.literal: Guizhou has sixty-two chief officials: Zhongcao, Bainuo, Yanglong, Huzhui, Chengfan, Shangma, Xiaocheng, Lufan, Fangfan, Weifan, Luofan, Wolong, Xiaolong, Dalong, Jinshi, Daping, Xiaoping, Dagulong, Xiaogulong, Mugua, Maxiang, Xintian, Pingfa, Yangchang, Muyi, Dingying, Shaying, Yangyi, Duyun, Bangshui, Sinan, Fengning Shang, Fengning Xia, Lantu, Pingding, Leping, Qiongshui, Pianqiao, Manyi, Yanhe, Langxi, Duding, Huangdao, Dusu, Shixi, Tanxi, Xinhua, Ouyang, Liangzhai, Hu'er, Zhonglin, Bazhou, Longli, Guzhou, Hongzhou, Shengxi, Tixi, Wuluo, Pingtou, Chuixi, Dizhai, and Yanmen.
translations.idiomatic: Guizhou has sixty-two chief officials: Zhongcao, Bainuo, Yanglong, Huzhui, Chengfan, Shangma, Xiaocheng, Lufan, Fangfan, Weifan, Luofan, Wolong, Xiaolong, Dalong, Jinshi, Daping, Xiaoping, Dagulong, Xiaogulong, Mugua, Maxiang, Xintian, Pingfa, Yangchang, Muyi, Dingying, Shaying, Yangyi, Duyun, Bangshui, Sinan, Upper and Lower Fengning, Lantu, Pingding, Leping, Qiongshui, Pianqiao, Manyi, Yanhe, Langxi, Duding, Huangdao, Dusu, Shixi, Tanxi, Xinhua, Ouyang, Liangzhai, Hu'er, Zhonglin, Bazhou, Longli, Guzhou, Hongzhou, Shengxi, Tixi, Wuluo, Pingtou, Chuixi, Dizhai, and Yanmen.

sentences.zh: 副長官司三：曰西堡，曰康莊，曰石門。

translations.literal: Three deputy chief officials: Xibao, Kangzhuang, and Shimen.
translations.idiomatic: Three deputy chief officials: Xibao, Kangzhuang, and Shimen.

sentences.zh: 廣西土州二十有六：曰忠州，曰歸德，曰果化，曰下雷，曰下石西，曰思陵，曰憑祥，曰江州，曰思州，曰萬承，曰太平，曰安平，曰龍英，曰都結，曰結安，曰上下凍，曰佶倫，曰茗州，曰茗盈，曰鎮遠，曰那地，曰南舟，曰田州，曰向武，曰都康，曰上映。

translations.literal: Guangxi has twenty-six native departments: Zhongzhou, Guide, Guohua, Xialei, Xiashixi, Siling, Pingxiang, Jiangzhou, Sizhou, Wancheng, Taiping, Anping, Longying, Dujie, Jie'an, Shangxia Dong, Jilun, Mingzhou, Mingying, Zhenyuan, Nadi, Nanzhou, Tianzhou, Xiangwu, Dukang, and Shangying.
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi has twenty-six native departments: Zhongzhou, Guide, Guohua, Xialei, Xiashixi, Siling, Pingxiang, Jiangzhou, Sizhou, Wancheng, Taiping, Anping, Longying, Dujie, Jie'an, Upper and Lower Dong, Jilun, Mingzhou, Mingying, Zhenyuan, Nadi, Nanzhou, Tianzhou, Xiangwu, Dukang, and Shangying.

sentences.zh: 土縣四：曰羅陽，曰上林，曰羅白，曰忻城。

translations.literal: Four native districts: Luoyang, Shanglin, Luobai, and Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: Four native districts: Luoyang, Shanglin, Luobai, and Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 長官司三：曰遷隆峒，曰永定，曰永順。

translations.literal: Three chief officials: Qianlongdong, Yongding, and Yongshun.
translations.idiomatic: Three chief officials: Qianlongdong, Yongding, and Yongshun.

sentences.zh: 凡宣慰、宣撫、安撫、長官等司之承襲隸兵部，土府、土州之承襲隸吏部。

translations.literal: Succession for pacification commissions, pacification prefectures, soothing commissions, chief officials, and the like fell under the Ministry of War; succession for native prefectures and native departments fell under the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Succession for pacification commissions, pacification prefectures, soothing commissions, and chief officials fell under the Ministry of War; succession for native prefectures and native departments fell under the Ministry of Personnel.

sentences.zh: 凡土司貢賦，或比年一貢，或三年一貢，各因其土產，穀米、牛馬、皮、布，皆折以銀，而會計於戶部。

translations.literal: Tribute and levies from native chieftains were paid either annually or every three years, according to local products—grain, cattle, hides, cloth—all converted to silver and accounted for at the Ministry of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: Tribute and levies from native chieftains were paid either annually or every three years, according to local products—grain, cattle, hides, cloth—all converted to silver and accounted for at the Ministry of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 雍正七年，川陝總督岳鍾琪奏四川巴塘、里塘等處請授宣撫司三員、安撫司九員、長官司十二員，給與印結號紙，副土官四員、千戶三員、百戶二十四員，給以職銜，以分職守。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Yongzheng, Sichuan-Shaanxi Governor-General Yue Zhongqi memorialized that Batang, Litang, and other places in Sichuan requested appointment of three pacification prefects, nine soothing commissioners, and twelve chief officials, with seals, credentials, and patent documents; four deputy native officials, three chiliarchs, and twenty-four centurions were to receive titles to divide duties.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 7, Governor-General Yue Zhongqi of Sichuan-Shaanxi memorialized that Batang, Litang, and other places in Sichuan sought appointment of three pacification prefects, nine soothing commissioners, and twelve chief officials, with seals, credentials, and patents; four deputy native officials, three chiliarchs, and twenty-four centurions were to receive titles to divide responsibilities.

sentences.zh: 內巴塘、裏塘正副土官原無世代頭目承襲，請照流官例。

translations.literal: The principal and deputy native officials of Batang and Litang originally had no hereditary clan heads to succeed them; he requested that they follow the regular-official precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The principal and deputy native officials of Batang and Litang originally had no hereditary clan heads to succeed them; he asked that they follow the regular-official precedent.

sentences.zh: 如有事故，開缺題補，與他土司不同。

translations.literal: If a vacancy occurred, the post would be opened and filled by imperial appointment—unlike other native chieftains.
translations.idiomatic: If a vacancy occurred, the post would be opened and filled by imperial appointment—unlike other native chieftains.

sentences.zh: 湖廣之西南隅，戰國時巫郡、黔中地。

translations.literal: The southwestern corner of Huguang was the territory of Wu Commandery and Qianzhong in the Warring States period.
translations.idiomatic: The southwestern corner of Huguang was the territory of Wu Commandery and Qianzhong in the Warring States period.

sentences.zh: 湖北之施南、容美，湖南之永順、保靖、桑植，境地毗連，介於岳、辰、常德、宜昌之間，與川東巴、夔相接壤，南通黔，西通蜀。

translations.literal: Shinan and Rongmei in Hubei and Yongshun, Baojing, and Sangzhi in Hunan adjoin one another, lying between Yuezhou, Chenzhou, Changde, and Yichang, bordering Ba and Kui in eastern Sichuan, reaching Guizhou in the south and Shu in the west.
translations.idiomatic: Shinan and Rongmei in Hubei and Yongshun, Baojing, and Sangzhi in Hunan adjoin one another, lying between Yuezhou, Chenzhou, Changde, and Yichang, bordering Ba and Kui in eastern Sichuan, reaching Guizhou in the south and Shu in the west.

sentences.zh: 元時所置宣慰、安撫、長官司之屬，明時因之。

translations.literal: The pacification commissions, soothing commissions, and chief officials established in the Yuan were retained in the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: The pacification commissions, soothing commissions, and chief officials established under the Yuan were retained under the Ming.

sentences.zh: 向推永、保諸宣慰，世席富強，兵亦果敢，每遇征伐，荷戈前驅，國家倚之為重。

translations.literal: The Yongshun and Baojing pacification commissioners had long enjoyed wealth and power; their troops were bold, and whenever campaigns arose they bore arms in the vanguard—the state relied on them heavily.
translations.idiomatic: The Yongshun and Baojing pacification commissioners had long enjoyed wealth and power; their troops were bold, and whenever campaigns arose they bore arms in the vanguard—the state relied on them heavily.

sentences.zh: 清有天下，僅施南、散毛、容美三宣撫使，永順、保靖兩宣慰使而已。

translations.literal: When the Qing gained the realm, only three pacification prefects remained—Shinan, Sanmao, and Rongmei—and two pacification commissioners, Yongshun and Baojing.
translations.idiomatic: When the Qing gained the realm, only three pacification prefects remained—Shinan, Sanmao, and Rongmei—and two pacification commissioners, Yongshun and Baojing.

sentences.zh: 雍正年間，施南、容美、永順、保靖先後納土，特設施南一府，隸北布政使，永順一府，隸南布政使。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng reign Shinan, Rongmei, Yongshun, and Baojing surrendered their lands in turn; a Shinan Prefecture was specially established under the northern provincial administration, and a Yongshun Prefecture under the southern.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng reign Shinan, Rongmei, Yongshun, and Baojing surrendered their domains in turn; a Shinan Prefecture was specially established under the northern provincial administration, and a Yongshun Prefecture under the southern.

sentences.zh: 兩府既設，合境無土司名目。

translations.literal: Once the two prefectures were established, the entire region had no native chieftain titles.
translations.idiomatic: Once the two prefectures were established, the entire region had no native chieftain titles left.

sentences.zh: 後有苗寇，分見各傳，不入此篇。

translations.literal: Later Miao bandit troubles are treated separately in other chapters and are not included here.
translations.idiomatic: Later Miao bandit troubles are treated separately in other chapters and are not included here.

sentences.zh: 施南：古巴地。

translations.literal: Shinan: ancient Ba territory.
translations.idiomatic: Shinan: ancient Ba territory.

sentences.zh: 秦、漢南郡蠻。

translations.literal: Under Qin and Han, the Yi of Nan Commandery.
translations.idiomatic: Under Qin and Han, the tribes of Nan Commandery.

sentences.zh: 唐施州。

translations.literal: Under Tang, Shizhou.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Tang, Shizhou.

sentences.zh: 元置施南宣撫司、忠孝安撫司。

translations.literal: The Yuan established the Shinan Pacification Prefecture and the Zhongxiao Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Yuan established the Shinan Pacification Prefecture and the Zhongxiao Soothing Commission.

sentences.zh: 明玉珍時，復置忠路宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the time of Ming Yuzhen, the Zhonglu Pacification Prefecture was re-established.
translations.idiomatic: In the time of Ming Yuzhen, the Zhonglu Pacification Prefecture was re-established.

sentences.zh: 明宣德三年，復置劍南長官司，立施州衛，領所一、宣撫司四、安撫司九、長官司十三、蠻夷官司五。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuande of the Ming, the Jiannan Chief Official was re-established and Shizhou Guard was founded, governing one battalion, four pacification prefectures, nine soothing commissions, thirteen chief officials, and five Man-Yi offices.
translations.idiomatic: In Xuande 3 (1428) the Jiannan Chief Official was re-established and Shizhou Guard was founded, governing one battalion, four pacification prefectures, nine soothing commissions, thirteen chief officials, and five Man-Yi offices.

sentences.zh: 清康熙三年，施州始歸順。

translations.literal: In the third year of Kangxi of the Qing, Shizhou first submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 3 (1664) Shizhou first submitted to the Qing.

sentences.zh: 四年，改沙溪宣慰司為宣撫司，改劍南長官司為建南長官司，而施南宣撫司、忠孝安撫司、忠路安撫司如故。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the Shaxi Pacification Commission was changed to a Pacification Prefecture, and the Jiannan Chief Official to the Jiannan Chief Official; the Shinan Pacification Prefecture, Zhongxiao Soothing Commission, and Zhonglu Soothing Commission remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the Shaxi Pacification Commission was reduced to a Pacification Prefecture, and the Jiannan Chief Official was renamed the Jiannan Chief Official; the Shinan Pacification Prefecture, Zhongxiao Soothing Commission, and Zhonglu Soothing Commission remained unchanged.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，從湖廣總督邁柱之請，裁施州衛，設恩施縣，改歸州直隸州，原管之十五土司並隸恩施縣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongzheng, at the request of Huguang Governor-General Mai Zhu, Shizhou Guard was abolished, Enshi County established, Guizhou made a directly governed department, and the fifteen native chieftains formerly under its jurisdiction placed under Enshi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6, at the request of Governor-General Mai Zhu of Huguang, Shizhou Guard was abolished, Enshi County established, Guizhou made a directly governed department, and the fifteen native chieftains formerly under its jurisdiction placed under Enshi County.

sentences.zh: 十二年，忠孝安撫司田璋納土，其地入於恩施縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year, Tian Zhang of the Zhongxiao Soothing Commission surrendered his domain, and his territory entered Enshi County.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year, Tian Zhang of the Zhongxiao Soothing Commission surrendered his domain, and his territory was incorporated into Enshi County.

sentences.zh: 十三年，施南宣撫司覃禹鼎以罪改流，於是忠峒土司田光祖等並請歸流，乃以十五土司並原設恩施縣，特設施南府，領六縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year, Qin Yuding of the Shinan Pacification Prefecture was converted to regular administration for a crime; thereupon Tian Guangzu of the Zhongdong native chieftain and others also petitioned for conversion. The fifteen native chieftains together with the existing Enshi County were combined to establish Shinan Prefecture specially, governing six counties.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year, Qin Yuding of the Shinan Pacification Prefecture was converted to regular administration for a crime; thereupon Tian Guangzu of the Zhongdong native chieftain and others also petitioned for conversion. The fifteen native chieftains together with the existing Enshi County were combined to establish Shinan Prefecture specially, governing six counties.

sentences.zh: 容美改鶴峰州，別隸宜昌府，領於巡荊道。

translations.literal: Rongmei was changed to Hefeng Department, separately subordinated to Yichang Prefecture and placed under the Xunjing circuit.
translations.idiomatic: Rongmei was changed to Hefeng Department, separately subordinated to Yichang Prefecture and placed under the Xunjing circuit.

sentences.zh: 明制，施州衛，轄三里、五所、三十一土司，市郭里、都亭里、崇寧里，附郭左、右、中三所，大田軍民千戶所，支羅鎮守百戶所。

translations.literal: Under the Ming system, Shizhou Guard governed three li, five battalions, and thirty-one native chieftains: Shiguoli, Dutingli, and Chongningli; the Left, Right, and Central battalions attached to the city; the Datian Military-Civilian Thousand-Household Battalion; and the Zhiluo Garrison Hundred-Household Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming system, Shizhou Guard governed three li, five battalions, and thirty-one native chieftains—the Shiguo, Duting, and Chongning li; the Left, Right, and Central city-attached battalions; the Datian Military-Civilian Thousand-Household Battalion; and the Zhiluo Garrison Hundred-Household Battalion.

sentences.zh: 大田所，元為散毛峒。

translations.literal: Datian Battalion—in the Yuan it was Sanmao Cave.
translations.idiomatic: Datian Battalion had been Sanmao Cave under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年定其地，二十三年屬千戶所，仍名散毛。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu of the Ming its territory was fixed; in the twenty-third year it was placed under a thousand-household battalion and still called Sanmao.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 (1372) its boundaries were fixed; in the twenty-third year it was placed under a thousand-household battalion and still called Sanmao.

sentences.zh: 尋改為大田軍民千戶所，領百戶所一、土官百戶所十、剌惹等三峒。

translations.literal: Soon after it was changed to the Datian Military-Civilian Thousand-Household Battalion, governing one hundred-household battalion, ten native-official hundred-household battalions, and three caves including Laren.
translations.idiomatic: It was soon renamed the Datian Military-Civilian Thousand-Household Battalion, governing one hundred-household battalion, ten native-official hundred-household battalions, and three caves including Laren.

sentences.zh: 支羅所，舊隸龍潭司。

translations.literal: Zhiluo Battalion was formerly subordinate to Longtan Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Zhiluo Battalion had formerly been subordinate to Longtan Commission.

sentences.zh: 明嘉靖四十四年，因峒長黃中叛，討平之，遂割半置所立屯，以百戶二員世鎮之，而今峒司屬焉。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year of Jiajing of the Ming, because cave chief Huang Zhong rebelled and was suppressed, half the territory was cut off to establish a battalion and garrison; two hundred-household officers were appointed to guard it in perpetuity, and the present cave commission was placed under it.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiajing 44 (1565), after cave chief Huang Zhong rebelled and was suppressed, half the territory was carved off to establish a battalion and garrison; two hundred-household officers were posted there in perpetuity, and the present cave commission was placed under its jurisdiction.

sentences.zh: 施南宣撫司，元施南道宣慰使。

translations.literal: Shinan Pacification Prefecture—in the Yuan it was the Shinan Circuit Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Shinan Pacification Prefecture had been the Shinan Circuit Pacification Commissioner under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，覃大富入朝，七年，升宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Qin Dafu came to court; in the seventh year it was promoted to Pacification Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371) Qin Dafu came to court; in the seventh year the office was promoted to Pacification Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清因之。

translations.literal: The Qing retained it.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing retained the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 雍正時，覃禹鼎襲。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng era, Qin Yuding succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng era Qin Yuding succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 禹鼎，容美土司田明如婿也，有罪輒匿容美。

translations.literal: Yuding was the son-in-law of Tian Mingru of the Rongmei native chieftain; whenever he committed offenses he would hide in Rongmei.
translations.idiomatic: Yuding was the son-in-law of Tian Mingru, the Rongmei native chieftain; whenever he committed an offense he would take refuge in Rongmei.

sentences.zh: 當事以明如之先從征紅苗有功，置勿問。

translations.literal: The authorities, because Mingru had earlier earned merit campaigning against the Red Miao, let the matter pass without inquiry.
translations.idiomatic: The authorities, citing Mingru's earlier merit in campaigning against the Red Miao, let the matter pass without inquiry.

sentences.zh: 十三年，明如被逮，自經死。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Mingru was arrested and hanged himself.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Mingru was arrested and hanged himself.

sentences.zh: 禹鼎以淫惡抗提，擬罪改流，以其地置利川縣。

translations.literal: Yuding, for lewdness and wickedness in resisting summons, was sentenced and converted to regular administration; his territory was made Lichuan County.
translations.idiomatic: Yuding, for lewd and wicked conduct in resisting official summons, was sentenced to conversion to regular administration; his territory was made Lichuan County.

sentences.zh: 東鄉安撫司，明玉珍置東鄉五路宣撫司。

translations.literal: Dongxiang Soothing Commission—Ming Yuzhen established the Dongxiang Five-Routes Pacification Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Dongxiang Soothing Commission had been the Dongxiang Five-Routes Pacification Prefecture established by Ming Yuzhen.

sentences.zh: 明洪武六年改安撫司，命覃起喇為之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu of the Ming it was changed to a Soothing Commission, and Qin Qila was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 6 (1373) it was changed to a Soothing Commission, and Qin Qila was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 清初歸附。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing they submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 雍正十年，覃壽椿以長子得罪正法，改流，以其地入恩施縣。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Yongzheng, Qin Shoucun's eldest son was executed for an offense; the domain was converted to regular administration and its territory incorporated into Enshi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 10 (1732), because Qin Shoucun's eldest son was executed for an offense, the domain was converted to regular administration and its territory was incorporated into Enshi County.

sentences.zh: 忠建宣撫司，明洪武四年，以田恩俊為之。

translations.literal: Zhongjian Pacification Prefecture—in the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Enjun was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongjian Pacification Prefecture—in Hongwu 4 (1371) Tian Enjun was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 六年，改宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year it was changed to Pacification Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year it was changed to a Pacification Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 清初歸附。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing they submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 雍正十一年，田興爵以橫暴不法擬流，以其地為恩施縣。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongzheng, Tian Xingjue was sentenced to conversion to regular administration for tyranny and lawlessness; his territory became Enshi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 11 (1733), Tian Xingjue was sentenced to conversion to regular administration for tyranny and lawlessness; his territory became Enshi County.

sentences.zh: 金峒安撫司，明洪武四年，以覃耳毛為之。

translations.literal: Jindong Soothing Commission—in the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Qin Ermao was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: Jindong Soothing Commission—in Hongwu 4 (1371) Qin Ermao was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 清初歸附。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing they submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 康熙四十三年，覃世英襲。

translations.literal: In the forty-third year of Kangxi, Qin Shiying succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 43 (1704) Qin Shiying succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 子邦舜，呈請改流，以其地為咸豐縣。

translations.literal: His son Bangshun petitioned for conversion to regular administration; the territory became Xianfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: His son Bangshun petitioned for conversion to regular administration, and the territory became Xianfeng County.

sentences.zh: 忠峒安撫司，元置湖南鎮邊宣慰司。

translations.literal: Zhongdong Soothing Commission—in the Yuan the Hunan Frontier Pacification Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongdong Soothing Commission had been the Hunan Frontier Pacification Commission established under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，命田璽玉為宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Xiyu was appointed Pacification Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371) Tian Xiyu was appointed Pacification Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永樂四年，改安撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongle, it was changed to Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 4 (1406) it was changed to a Soothing Commission.

sentences.zh: 清初田楚珍歸附，調征播州有功，仍准襲職。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing Tian Chuzhen submitted; for merit in the Bozhou campaign he was still permitted to succeed to office.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing Tian Chuzhen submitted; for merit in the Bozhou campaign he was still permitted to succeed to office.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年，田光祖糾十五土司呈請納土歸流，以其地入宣恩縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng, Tian Guangzu rallied fifteen native chieftains to petition surrendering their domains and converting to regular administration; their territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1734), Tian Guangzu rallied fifteen native chieftains to petition surrendering their domains and converting to regular administration; their territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.

sentences.zh: 散毛宣撫司，元為散毛府。

translations.literal: Sanmao Pacification Prefecture—in the Yuan it was Sanmao Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Sanmao Pacification Prefecture had been Sanmao Prefecture under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 至正六年，改宣撫司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Zhi Zheng, it was changed to Pacification Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhi Zheng 6 (1346) it was changed to a Pacification Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，命覃野旺為宣撫司，割其半為大田所。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Qin Yewang was appointed Pacification Prefecture; half was cut off as Datian Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371) Qin Yewang was appointed Pacification Prefecture, and half the territory was carved off as Datian Battalion.

sentences.zh: 清初覃勳麟歸附，仍准襲職。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing Qin Xunlin submitted and was still permitted to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing Qin Xunlin submitted and was still permitted to succeed to office.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，覃烜納土，以其地入來鳳縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Qin Xuan surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Qin Xuan surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.

sentences.zh: 忠路安撫司，明洪武四年，命覃英為安撫司。

translations.literal: Zhonglu Soothing Commission—in the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Qin Ying was appointed Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Zhonglu Soothing Commission—in Hongwu 4 (1371) Qin Ying was appointed Soothing Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 清康熙元年，覃承國歸附，以征譚逆功襲前職。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi of the Qing, Qin Chengguo submitted; for merit campaigning against the Tan rebel he succeeded to his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662) Qin Chengguo submitted; for merit in campaigning against the Tan rebel he succeeded to his former office.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，覃楚梓納土，以其地改利川縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Qin Chuzi surrendered his domain; the territory was changed to Lichuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Qin Chuzi surrendered his domain, and the territory was made Lichuan County.

sentences.zh: 忠孝安撫司，元至正十一年，改軍民府。

translations.literal: Zhongxiao Soothing Commission—in the eleventh year of Zhi Zheng of the Yuan, it was changed to Military-Civilian Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongxiao Soothing Commission—in Zhi Zheng 11 (1351) it was changed to a Military-Civilian Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，以田墨施為安撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Moshi was appointed Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371) Tian Moshi was appointed Soothing Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 清因之。

translations.literal: The Qing retained it.
translations.idiomatic: The Qing retained the arrangement.

sentences.zh: 康熙八年，田京襲，累授總兵。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Kangxi, Tian Jing succeeded and was repeatedly appointed regional commander.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 8 (1669) Tian Jing succeeded to the office and was repeatedly appointed regional commander.

sentences.zh: 十九年，告休。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year he requested retirement.
translations.idiomatic: In the nineteenth year he requested retirement.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田璋納土，以其地為恩施縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Zhang surrendered his domain; the territory became Enshi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Zhang surrendered his domain, and the territory became Enshi County.

sentences.zh: 高羅安撫司，元高羅寨長官司。

translations.literal: Gaoluo Soothing Commission—in the Yuan, Gaoluo Stockade Chief Official.
translations.idiomatic: Gaoluo Soothing Commission had been the Gaoluo Stockade Chief Official under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武六年，改安撫司，以田大名為之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu of the Ming, it was changed to Soothing Commission; Tian Daming was appointed to it.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 6 (1373) it was changed to a Soothing Commission, and Tian Daming was appointed to the post.

sentences.zh: 清順治初，田飛龍歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi of the Qing, Tian Feilong submitted and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: In early Shunzhi Tian Feilong submitted and was still permitted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田昭納土，以其地入宣恩縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Zhao surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Zhao surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.

sentences.zh: 木冊長官司，元置安撫司。

translations.literal: Muce Chief Official—in the Yuan a Soothing Commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Muce Chief Official had been a Soothing Commission established under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明永樂六年，改長官司，以田穀佐為長官司。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongle of the Ming, it was changed to Chief Official; Tian Guzuo was appointed Chief Official.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongle 6 (1408) it was changed to a Chief Official domain, and Tian Guzuo was appointed Chief Official.

sentences.zh: 清初，田經國歸附，仍與世襲。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing, Tian Jingguo submitted and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing Tian Jingguo submitted and was still granted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田應鼎納土，以其地入宣恩縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Yingding surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Yingding surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Xuan'en County.

sentences.zh: 大旺安撫司，元至正置。

translations.literal: Dawang Soothing Commission—established in Zhi Zheng of the Yuan.
translations.idiomatic: Dawang Soothing Commission was established in the Zhi Zheng era of the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武四年，以田驢蹄為安撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Lüti was appointed Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 4 (1371) Tian Lüti was appointed Soothing Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 清康熙初，田永封歸附，仍准襲職。

translations.literal: In early Kangxi of the Qing, Tian Yongfeng submitted and was still permitted to succeed.
translations.idiomatic: In early Kangxi Tian Yongfeng submitted and was still permitted to succeed to office.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田正元納土，以其地入來鳳縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Zhengyuan surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Zhengyuan surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.

sentences.zh: 臨壁長官司，原附大旺。

translations.literal: Linbi Chief Official—originally attached to Dawang.
translations.idiomatic: Linbi Chief Official had originally been attached to Dawang.

sentences.zh: 清康熙元年，頒給田琦印信，仍與世襲。

translations.literal: In the first year of Kangxi of the Qing, a seal was conferred on Tian Qi, and hereditary succession was still granted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 1 (1662) a seal was conferred on Tian Qi, and hereditary succession was still granted.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田封疆納土，以其地入來鳳縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Fengjiang surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Fengjiang surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.

sentences.zh: 東流安撫司，原附大旺。

translations.literal: Dongliu Soothing Commission—originally attached to Dawang.
translations.idiomatic: Dongliu Soothing Commission had originally been attached to Dawang.

sentences.zh: 唐崖長官司，元置千戶所。

translations.literal: Tangya Chief Official—in the Yuan a Thousand-Household Battalion was established.
translations.idiomatic: Tangya Chief Official had been a Thousand-Household Battalion established under the Yuan.

sentences.zh: 明洪武七年，改長官司。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Hongwu of the Ming, it was changed to Chief Official.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 7 (1374) it was changed to a Chief Official domain.

sentences.zh: 清初覃宗禹歸附，仍與世襲。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing, Qin Zongyu submitted and was still granted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing Qin Zongyu submitted and was still granted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，覃梓桂納土，以其地入咸豐縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Qin Zigui surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Qin Zigui surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.

sentences.zh: 龍潭安撫司，明洪武四年，以田應虎為安撫司。

translations.literal: Longtan Soothing Commission—in the fourth year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Yinghu was appointed Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Longtan Soothing Commission—in Hongwu 4 (1371) Tian Yinghu was appointed Soothing Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 清初歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing they submitted; hereditary succession was still permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing they submitted to the dynasty, and hereditary succession was still permitted.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，田貴龍納土，以其地入咸豐縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Tian Guilong surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Tian Guilong surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.

sentences.zh: 沙溪安撫司，明置。

translations.literal: Shaxi Soothing Commission—established in the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Shaxi Soothing Commission was established in the Ming.

sentences.zh: 清初歸附。

translations.literal: Early in the Qing they submitted.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qing they submitted to the dynasty.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，黃天奇襲安撫司。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi, Huang Tianqi succeeded to the Soothing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 (1665) Huang Tianqi succeeded to the Soothing Commission.

sentences.zh: 天奇子楚昌。

translations.literal: Tianqi's son was Chuchang.
translations.idiomatic: Tianqi's son was Chuchang.

sentences.zh: 初，楚昌入施州衛學為諸生。

translations.literal: At first Chuchang entered Shizhou Guard School as a student.
translations.idiomatic: At first Chuchang entered Shizhou Guard School as a licentiate.

sentences.zh: 時諸司爭並，民鮮知禮，楚昌折節力學，有時名。

translations.literal: At the time the various commissions vied to annex one another and the people scarcely knew propriety; Chuchang restrained himself and studied diligently, gaining a reputation of the age.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the various commissions vied to annex one another and the people scarcely knew propriety; Chuchang humbled himself and studied hard, winning a reputation in his day.

sentences.zh: 及襲職，設官學，公餘與多士講肄，多所成就。

translations.literal: When he succeeded to office he established an official school; in his spare hours he lectured and studied with many scholars, and many achieved distinction.
translations.idiomatic: When he succeeded to office he established an official school; in his spare hours he lectured and studied with many scholars, and many of them went on to distinction.

sentences.zh: 楚昌死，子正爵襲。

translations.literal: When Chuchang died, his son Zhengjue succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: When Chuchang died, his son Zhengjue succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，改流，其地入於利川縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, it was converted to regular administration; the territory was incorporated into Lichuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) it was converted to regular administration, and the territory was incorporated into Lichuan County.

sentences.zh: 卯峒長官司，清雍正十三年，長官司向舜納土，以其地入來鳳縣。

translations.literal: Maodong Chief Official—in the thirteenth year of Yongzheng of the Qing, Chief Official Xiang Shun surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: Maodong Chief Official—in Yongzheng 13 (1735) Chief Official Xiang Shun surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.

sentences.zh: 漫水宣撫司，清初，宣撫司向國泰歸附，仍准世襲。

translations.literal: Manshui Pacification Prefecture—early Qing, Pacification Commissioner Xiang Guotai submitted and was still permitted hereditary succession.
translations.idiomatic: Manshui Pacification Prefecture—early in the Qing, Pacification Commissioner Xiang Guotai submitted and was still permitted hereditary succession.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，向庭官納土，其地入於來鳳縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Xiang Tingguan surrendered his domain; the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) Xiang Tingguan surrendered his domain, and the territory was incorporated into Laifeng County.

sentences.zh: 西萍長官司，雍正十三年裁，其地入於咸豐縣。

translations.literal: Xiping Chief Official—abolished in the thirteenth year of Yongzheng; the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.
translations.idiomatic: Xiping Chief Official was abolished in Yongzheng 13 (1735), and the territory was incorporated into Xianfeng County.

sentences.zh: 建南長官司，明宣德五年置。

translations.literal: Jiannan Chief Official—established in the fifth year of Xuande of the Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Jiannan Chief Official was established in Xuande 5 (1430).

sentences.zh: 清雍正十三年裁，其地入於利川縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng of the Qing it was abolished; the territory was incorporated into Lichuan County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735) it was abolished, and the territory was incorporated into Lichuan County.

sentences.zh: 容美土司，唐元和元年，田行皋從高崇文討平劉辟，授施溱溶萬招討把截使，仍知四州事。

translations.literal: Rongmei native chieftain—in the first year of Yuanhe of the Tang, Tian Xinggao followed Gao Chongwen in suppressing Liu Pi and was appointed Pacification-and-Interception Commissioner of Shi, Qin, Rong, and Wan, and continued to administer the affairs of the four prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The Rongmei native chieftain—in Yuanhe 1 (806) Tian Xinggao followed Gao Chongwen in suppressing Liu Pi and was appointed Pacification-and-Interception Commissioner over Shi, Qin, Rong, and Wan, and continued to administer the affairs of the four prefectures.

sentences.zh: 宋有田思政。

translations.literal: In the Song there was Tian Minzheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song there was Tian Minzheng.

sentences.zh: 元有田乾亨。

translations.literal: In the Yuan there was Tian Qianheng.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan there was Tian Qianheng.

sentences.zh: 明洪武三年，田光寶以元所授誥敕詣行在請換，乃命光寶仍為宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu of the Ming, Tian Guangbao brought the patents conferred by the Yuan to the temporary capital to request reissuance; Guangbao was then appointed Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 3 (1370) Tian Guangbao brought the patents conferred by the Yuan to the temporary capital to request reissuance, and Guangbao was then appointed Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 傳至田既霖，清順治間歸附，仍授宣慰使。

translations.literal: The line passed to Tian Jilin; in the Shunzhi era of the Qing he submitted and was still appointed Pacification Commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: The line passed to Tian Jilin; in the Shunzhi era he submitted to the Qing and was still appointed Pacification Commissioner.

sentences.zh: 子甘霖襲。

translations.literal: His son Ganlin succeeded.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ganlin succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 甘霖字特雲，著合浦集。

translations.literal: Ganlin, styled Teyun, authored the Hepu Collection.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlin, styled Teyun, authored the Hepu Collection.

sentences.zh: 甘霖子舜年，字九峰，受吳逆偽承恩伯敕，後繳。

translations.literal: Ganlin's son Shunnian, styled Jiufeng, received a false patent as Baron of Chengen from the Wu rebel, later surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: Ganlin's son Shunnian, styled Jiufeng, had accepted a false patent as Baron of Chengen from the Wu rebel, which he later surrendered.

sentences.zh: 奉檄從征有勞績，頗招名流習文史，刻有廿一史纂。

translations.literal: Obeying orders he campaigned with meritorious service; he greatly recruited distinguished men to study literature and history, and printed the Twenty-One Histories Compendium.
translations.idiomatic: Obeying orders he campaigned with meritorious service; he greatly recruited distinguished men to study literature and history, and had the Twenty-One Histories Compendium printed.

sentences.zh: 日自課，某日讀某經、閱某史至某處，刻於書之空處，用小印志之。

translations.literal: He set himself daily lessons: on such-and-such a day he read such-and-such a classic or perused such-and-such a history to such-and-such a point—he had this carved in the blank margins of books and marked it with a small seal.
translations.idiomatic: He set himself daily lessons: on such-and-such a day he read such-and-such a classic or perused such-and-such a history to such-and-such a point—he had this carved in the blank margins of his books and marked it with a small seal.

sentences.zh: 有白鹿堂集、容陽世述錄。

translations.literal: He had the Bailu Hall Collection and the Rongyang Hereditary Chronicle.
translations.idiomatic: He authored the Bailu Hall Collection and the Rongyang Hereditary Chronicle.

sentences.zh: 子明如襲職。

translations.literal: His son Mingru succeeded to office.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingru succeeded to the office.

sentences.zh: 以放肆為趙申喬劾奏，奉旨原宥。

translations.literal: For license he was impeached by Zhao Shenqiao; an imperial decree pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: For license he was impeached by Zhao Shenqiao, but an imperial decree pardoned him.

sentences.zh: 雍正十一年，再為邁柱嚴參，明如移駐平山寨儗抗拒，為石樑長官司張彤砫催迫，明如自盡。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Yongzheng, he was again severely impeached by Mai Zhu; Mingru moved his headquarters to Pingshan Stockade intending to resist, was pressed by Zhang Tongzhu of the Shiliang Chief Official, and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 11 (1733) he was again severely impeached by Mai Zhu; Mingru moved his headquarters to Pingshan Stockade intending to resist, was pressed by Zhang Tongzhu of the Shiliang Chief Official, and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 改土歸流，改司為鶴峰州，隸宜昌府。

translations.literal: The native domain was converted to regular administration; the commission was changed to Hefeng Department, subordinate to Yichang Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: The native domain was converted to regular administration; the commission was changed to Hefeng Department, subordinate to Yichang Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 永順：漢武陵，隋辰州，唐溪州地。

translations.literal: Yongshun: Under Han, Wuling; under Sui, Chenzhou; under Tang, Xizhou territory.
translations.idiomatic: Yongshun: Under the Han it was Wuling; under the Sui, Chenzhou; under the Tang, Xizhou territory.

sentences.zh: 宋時為永順州。

translations.literal: Under the Song it was Yongshun Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it became Yongshun Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元時，彭萬潛自改為永順等處軍民安撫司。

translations.literal: In Yuan times, Peng Wanqian on his own initiative changed [the office] to the Yongshun and Other Places Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan, Peng Wanqian reorganized the domain as the Yongshun and Other Places Military-Civilian Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年，改宣慰使。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu of Ming, [it] was changed to pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 (1372) it was converted to a pacification commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，恭順王孔有德至辰州，宣慰使彭宏澎率三知州、六長官、三百八十峒苗蠻歸附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, Prince Gongshun Kong Youde reached Chenzhou; Pacification Commissioner Peng Hongpeng led three native prefects, six chief officials, and three hundred eighty stockades of Miao and Man tribes in submission.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647), Prince Gongshun Kong Youde reached Chenzhou, and Pacification Commissioner Peng Hongpeng brought over three native prefects, six chief officials, and the people of three hundred eighty Miao and Man stockades in submission.

sentences.zh: 十四年，頒給宣慰使印，並設流官經歷一員。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year, the seal of pacification commissioner was issued, and one regular-administration registrar was also established.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year (1657), the pacification commissioner's seal was issued and a regular-administration registrar was appointed.

sentences.zh: 康熙十年，吳三桂叛踞辰龍關，授永順宣慰使彭廷椿偽印，廷椿繳之。

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Kangxi, Wu Sangui rebelled and seized Chenlong Pass; he granted a false seal to Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Tingchun, and Tingchun surrendered it.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 10 (1671), Wu Sangui rebelled and held Chenlong Pass; he issued a false seal to Yongshun Pacification Commissioner Peng Tingchun, but Tingchun turned it in.

sentences.zh: 奉旨賞其子宏海總兵銜，令率土兵協剿，有功，授宣慰司印。

translations.literal: By imperial order his son Honghai was granted the rank of regional commander; he was ordered to lead native troops in joint suppression, and for merit was granted the seal of the pacification commission.
translations.idiomatic: By imperial order his son Honghai received the rank of regional commander and was sent to lead native troops in the joint campaign; for his merit he was granted the pacification commission's seal.

sentences.zh: 雍正六年，宣慰使彭肇槐納土，請歸江西祖籍，有旨嘉獎，授參將，並世襲拖沙喇哈番之職，賜銀一萬兩，聽其在江西祖籍立產安插，改永順司為府，附郭為永順縣，分永順白崖峒地為龍山縣。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongzheng, Pacification Commissioner Peng Zhaohuai surrendered the land, requesting to return to his ancestral home in Jiangxi; an edict commended him, he was appointed colonel, and was granted the hereditary post of Tuwashalahafan, with ten thousand taels of silver; he was permitted to establish property and settle in his ancestral Jiangxi home; the Yongshun Commission was changed to a prefecture, the attached seat becoming Yongshun County, and the Baiya Cave territory of Yongshun was divided off as Longshan County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 6 (1728), Pacification Commissioner Peng Zhaohuai returned his native domain and asked to resettle in his ancestral home in Jiangxi. An edict praised him; he was made a colonel and granted the hereditary rank of Tuwashalahafan, with ten thousand taels of silver, and permission to establish estates and settle in Jiangxi. The Yongshun Commission became a prefecture, its seat became Yongshun County, and the Baiya Cave region was split off as Longshan County.

sentences.zh: 南渭州土知州，屬永順司。

translations.literal: Nanwei Prefecture native prefect, subordinate to Yongshun Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Nanwei Prefecture native prefecture was subordinate to the Yongshun Commission.

sentences.zh: 元至元中，置安撫司。

translations.literal: In the Zhongyuan period of Yuan, a pacification commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: During the Yuan Zhongyuan era a pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二年，以彭萬金為土知州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu of Ming, Peng Wanjin was appointed native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 (1369), Peng Wanjin was appointed native prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至彭應麟，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Peng Yinglin; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Peng Yinglin, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，彭宗國納土，以其地入永順縣。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Peng Zongguo surrendered the land; its territory was incorporated into Yongshun County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Peng Zongguo returned his domain, and its lands were annexed to Yongshun County.

sentences.zh: 施溶州土知州，在永順司東南。

translations.literal: Shirong Prefecture native prefect, southeast of Yongshun Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Shirong Prefecture native prefecture lay southeast of the Yongshun Commission.

sentences.zh: 元會溪、施溶等處長官司。

translations.literal: Under Yuan, the Huixi and Shirong and Other Places Chief Official.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it was the Huixi, Shirong, and Other Places Chief Official.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二年，改州，以田建霸為土知州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu of Ming, [it] was changed to a prefecture, and Tian Jianba was appointed native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 (1369) it was converted to a prefecture, with Tian Jianba as native prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至田茂年，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Tian Maonian; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Tian Maonian, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，田永豐納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Tian Yongfeng surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Tian Yongfeng returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 上溪州土知州，屬永順司。

translations.literal: Shangxi Prefecture native prefect, subordinate to Yongshun Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Shangxi Prefecture native prefecture was subordinate to the Yongshun Commission.

sentences.zh: 明洪武二年，以張義保為土知州。

translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu of Ming, Zhang Yibao was appointed native prefect.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 2 (1369), Zhang Yibao was appointed native prefect.

sentences.zh: 傳至張漢卿，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zhang Hanqing; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Zhang Hanqing, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，張漢儒納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Zhang Hanru surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Zhang Hanru returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 臘惹峒長官司，元屬思州，以向孛爍為總管。

translations.literal: Layre Cave Chief Official; under Yuan subordinate to Sizhou, with Xiang Boluo as superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: The Layre Cave Chief Official. Under the Yuan it belonged to Sizhou, with Xiang Boluo as superintendent.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年，改屬永順司，以田世貴為長官司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu of Ming, subordination was changed to Yongshun Commission, and Tian Shigui was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 (1372) it was transferred to the Yongshun Commission, with Tian Shigui as chief official.

sentences.zh: 傳至田仕朝，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Tian Shichao; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Tian Shichao, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，田中和納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Tian Zhonghe surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Tian Zhonghe returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 麥著黃峒長官司，元曰麥著土村，屬思州。

translations.literal: Maizhu Huang Cave Chief Official; under Yuan called Maizhu Native Village, subordinate to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Maizhu Huang Cave Chief Official. Under the Yuan it was called Maizhu Native Village and belonged to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年，改屬永順司，以黃穀踵為長官司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu of Ming, subordination was changed to Yongshun Commission, and Huang Guzhong was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 (1372) it was transferred to the Yongshun Commission, with Huang Guzhong as chief official.
