sentences.zh: 傳至黃甲，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Huang Jia; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Huang Jia, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，黃正乾納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Huang Zhengqian surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Huang Zhengqian returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 驢遲峒長官司，元屬思州。

translations.literal: Lvchi Cave Chief Official; under Yuan subordinate to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Lvchi Cave Chief Official. Under the Yuan it belonged to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 明洪武五年，改屬永順司，以向迪踵為長官司。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Hongwu of Ming, subordination was changed to Yongshun Commission, and Xiang Dizhong was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: In Hongwu 5 (1372) it was transferred to the Yongshun Commission, with Xiang Dizhong as chief official.

sentences.zh: 傳至向光胄，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Xiang Guangzhou; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Xiang Guangzhou, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，向錫爵納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Xiang Xijue surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Xiang Xijue returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 施溶溪長官司，元屬思州。

translations.literal: Shirong Stream Chief Official; under Yuan subordinate to Sizhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Shirong Stream Chief Official. Under the Yuan it belonged to Sizhou.

sentences.zh: 明初，改屬永順司，以汪良為長官司。

translations.literal: In early Ming, subordination was changed to Yongshun Commission, and Wang Liang was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming it was transferred to the Yongshun Commission, with Wang Liang as chief official.

sentences.zh: 傳至汪世忠，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Wang Shizhong; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Wang Shizhong, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，汪文珂納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Wang Wenke surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Wang Wenke returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 白岩峒長官司，元屬葛蠻安撫司。

translations.literal: Baiyan Cave Chief Official; under Yuan subordinate to Geman Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Baiyan Cave Chief Official. Under the Yuan it belonged to the Geman Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明初，改屬永順司，以張那律為長官司。

translations.literal: In early Ming, subordination was changed to Yongshun Commission, and Zhang Nalu was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: In the early Ming it was transferred to the Yongshun Commission, with Zhang Nalu as chief official.

sentences.zh: 傳至張四教，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Zhang Sijiao; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Zhang Sijiao, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，張宗略納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Zhang Zonglue surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Zhang Zonglue returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 田家峒長官司，明洪武三年，以田勝祖為長官司。

translations.literal: Tianjia Cave Chief Official; in the third year of Hongwu of Ming, Tian Shengzu was appointed chief official.
translations.idiomatic: The Tianjia Cave Chief Official. In Hongwu 3 (1370), Tian Shengzu was appointed chief official.

sentences.zh: 傳至田興祿，清順治四年，歸附。

translations.literal: The line passed to Tian Xinglu; in the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, [he] submitted.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Tian Xinglu, who submitted in Shunzhi 4 (1647).

sentences.zh: 雍正五年，田藎臣納土。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Yongzheng, Tian Jinchen surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 5 (1727), Tian Jinchen returned his domain.

sentences.zh: 保靖宣慰司，亦唐溪州地。

translations.literal: Baojing Pacification Commission, also Xizhou territory of Tang.
translations.idiomatic: The Baojing Pacification Commission was also Tang-era Xizhou territory.

sentences.zh: 宋曰保靜州。

translations.literal: Under Song it was called Baojing Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Song it was known as Baojing Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 元為保靖州安撫司。

translations.literal: Under Yuan it was Baojing Prefecture Pacification Commission.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan it became the Baojing Prefecture Pacification Commission.

sentences.zh: 明仍為安撫使。

translations.literal: Under Ming it remained pacification commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming it remained a pacification commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，明宣慰司彭象乾之子彭朝柱歸附。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, Peng Zhaozhu, son of Ming Pacification Commissioner Peng Xiangqian, submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647), Peng Zhaozhu, son of the Ming pacification commissioner Peng Xiangqian, submitted.

sentences.zh: 象乾曾孫澤虹病廢，其妻彭氏用事。

translations.literal: Xiangqian's great-grandson Ze Hong was disabled by illness; his wife Lady Peng held power.
translations.idiomatic: Xiangqian's great-grandson Ze Hong was incapacitated by illness, and his wife Lady Peng wielded authority.

sentences.zh: 漢奸高倫、張為任二人結連其舍把長官彭澤蛟、彭祖裕等，相與樹黨，以劫殺為事。

translations.literal: Han traitors Gao Lun and Zhang Weiren linked with his sheba chief officials Peng Zejiao, Peng Zuyu, and others, forming factions together and making plunder and murder their trade.
translations.idiomatic: The Han collaborators Gao Lun and Zhang Weiren allied with his subordinate chief officials Peng Zejiao, Peng Zuyu, and others, building factions and making robbery and murder their livelihood.

sentences.zh: 雍正元年，澤虹死，子御彬幼，澤蛟欲奪其職，為禦彬所遏。

translations.literal: In the first year of Yongzheng, Ze Hong died; his son Yubin was young, and Zejiao wished to seize his office but was blocked by Yubin.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 1 (1723), Ze Hong died. His son Peng Yubin was still a child, and Zejiao tried to seize the office but was thwarted by Yubin.

sentences.zh: 迨御彬襲職，肆為淫凶，澤蛟與其弟澤虬合謀，互相劫殺。

translations.literal: When Yubin succeeded to office, he indulged in lewdness and violence; Zejiao and his brother Zeqiu plotted together, and each side carried out raids and killings.
translations.idiomatic: Once Yubin succeeded to the office, he gave himself over to lewdness and cruelty; Zejiao and his brother Zeqiu plotted together, and the factions raided and killed one another.

sentences.zh: 二年，御彬以追緝澤蛟為名，潛結容美土司田旻如、桑植土司向國棟，率土兵搶虜保靖民財。

translations.literal: In the second year, Yubin under the pretext of pursuing Zejiao secretly allied with Rongmei native chieftain Tian Minru and Sangzhi native chieftain Xiang Guodong, leading native troops to plunder Baojing commoners' property.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year (1724), Peng Yubin, claiming to pursue Zejiao, secretly allied with Rongmei chieftain Tian Minru and Sangzhi chieftain Xiang Guodong and led native troops to plunder the property of Baojing commoners.

sentences.zh: 七年，御彬安置遼陽，以其地為保靖縣。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, Yubin was resettled in Liaoyang, and his territory became Baojing County.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year (1729), Peng Yubin was resettled in Liaoyang; his domain was converted to Baojing County.

sentences.zh: 大喇司，在龍山縣，屬保靖司。

translations.literal: Dala Commission, in Longshan County, subordinate to Baojing Commission.
translations.idiomatic: The Dala Commission lay in Longshan County and was subordinate to the Baojing Commission.

sentences.zh: 明正德十五年，以土舍彭惠協理巡檢事。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Zhengde of Ming, native cadet Peng Hui was appointed to assist in patrol affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhengde 15 (1520), native cadet Peng Hui was appointed to assist in patrol duties.

sentences.zh: 傳至彭禦佶，雍正十三年，納土。

translations.literal: The line passed to Peng Yuji; in the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, [he] surrendered the land.
translations.idiomatic: The line descended to Peng Yuji, who returned his domain in Yongzheng 13 (1735).

sentences.zh: 桑植宣慰司，本慈利縣地。

translations.literal: Sangzhi Pacification Commission, originally Cili County territory.
translations.idiomatic: The Sangzhi Pacification Commission was originally part of Cili County.

sentences.zh: 元有上桑植、下桑植宣慰司。

translations.literal: Under Yuan there were Upper Sangzhi and Lower Sangzhi pacification commissions.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Yuan there were separate Upper and Lower Sangzhi pacification commissions.

sentences.zh: 明置安撫司。

translations.literal: Under Ming a pacification commission was established.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Ming a pacification commission was established.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，宣慰司向鼎歸附，授原職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, Pacification Commissioner Xiang Ding submitted and was granted his former office.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647), Pacification Commissioner Xiang Ding submitted and was confirmed in his former post.

sentences.zh: 鼎子長庚調鎮古州八萬。

translations.literal: Ding's son Chang Geng was transferred to command the garrison at Guzhou Bawan.
translations.idiomatic: Ding's son Chang Geng was transferred to command the Bawan garrison at Guzhou.

sentences.zh: 長庚子向國棟殘虐，與容美、永順、茅岡各土司相仇殺，民不堪命。

translations.literal: Chang Geng's son Xiang Guodong was cruel and tyrannical; he feuded with the Rongmei, Yongshun, and Maogang native chieftains, killing one another; the people could not bear it.
translations.idiomatic: Chang Geng's son Xiang Guodong ruled with brutal cruelty, feuding with the Rongmei, Yongshun, and Maogang chieftains in mutual slaughter until the people could endure no more.

sentences.zh: 雍正四年，土經歷唐宗聖與國棟弟國柄等相率赴愬，總督傅敏入奏，乃繳追印篆，國棟安置河南，以其地為桑植縣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Yongzheng, native registrar Tang Zongsheng together with Guodong's brother Guobing and others led a joint petition; Governor-General Fu Min memorialized the throne; then the seals were demanded and surrendered, Guodong was resettled in Henan, and his territory became Sangzhi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 4 (1726), native registrar Tang Zongsheng joined Guodong's brother Guobing and others in a joint appeal to the throne. After Governor-General Fu Min memorialized, the seals were recalled, Guodong was resettled in Henan, and his domain was converted to Sangzhi County.

sentences.zh: 上下峒長官司，明置宣撫司，復改為長官司，而分其地為二。

translations.literal: Upper and Lower Cave Chief Officials; under Ming a pacification commissioner was established, then changed again to chief officials, and its territory was divided into two.
translations.idiomatic: The Upper and Lower Cave Chief Officials. The Ming first established a pacification commissioner, then converted the office to chief officials and split the territory in two.

sentences.zh: 清康熙二年，向九鸞、向日葵歸附。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kangxi of Qing, Xiang Jiuluan and Xiang Rikui submitted.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 2 (1663), Xiang Jiuluan and Xiang Rikui submitted.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，給九鸞上峒長官司印，日葵下峒長官司印。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, Jiuluan was given the Upper Cave chief official seal, and Rikui the Lower Cave chief official seal.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year (1682), Jiuluan received the Upper Cave chief-official seal and Rikui the Lower Cave chief-official seal.

sentences.zh: 雍正十三年，上峒司向玉衡、下峒司向良佐納土，以其地屬桑植縣。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Yongzheng, Upper Cave Commissioner Xiang Yuheng and Lower Cave Commissioner Xiang Liangzuo surrendered the land; their territories were placed under Sangzhi County.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 13 (1735), Upper Cave Commissioner Xiang Yuheng and Lower Cave Commissioner Xiang Liangzuo returned their domains, and their lands were annexed to Sangzhi County.

sentences.zh: 茅岡長官司，明改天平千戶所。

translations.literal: Maogang Chief Official; under Ming changed to Tianping Guard Battalion.
translations.idiomatic: The Maogang Chief Official. Under the Ming it was converted to the Tianping Guard Battalion.

sentences.zh: 清順治四年，石門天平所千戶覃祚昌、茅岡長官覃廕祚等相繼歸附，給與印信。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi of Qing, Shimen Tianping Guard Battalion Battalion Commander Tan Zuchang, Maogang Chief Official Tan Yinzuo, and others submitted in succession and were given seals.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 (1647), Shimen Tianping Guard Battalion Commander Tan Zuchang, Maogang Chief Official Tan Yinzuo, and others submitted in succession and received official seals.

sentences.zh: 雍正十二年，茅岡土司覃純一納土，石門天平所、慈利麻寮所相繼請設流官，分其地屬石門、慈利、安福三縣。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Yongzheng, Maogang native chieftain Tan Chunyi surrendered the land; Shimen Tianping Guard Battalion and Cili Maliao Guard Battalion successively requested regular administrators; their territories were divided and placed under Shimen, Cili, and Anfu counties.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongzheng 12 (1734), Maogang chieftain Tan Chunyi returned his domain. The Shimen Tianping and Cili Maliao guard battalions successively petitioned for regular administrators, and their territories were divided among Shimen, Cili, and Anfu counties.
